description: Size-based rotation: each file moves to .1 before a line would pass the cap, older archives shift up, and three are kept. ERROR lines only, so no boot line sits in the files. Each case's expected value lists every log file with its size, line count and first and last lines cut to 60 units.

cases.name: 400 lines across many rotations keep three archives, each under the cap
a file seeded past the cap is archived before the first line
a file seeded just under the cap takes the next line, then rotates
a line over the cap is written alone and rotates out with the next line
